title: The Stratospheric Black Blizzard
bodyText: At -38°C, the stratospheric ash layer plunges to ground level in an atmospheric inversion. Pitch black at 11:00 AM. Sub-micron radioactive soot packs into intake cowling grilles. The blower motor temperature spikes into red as the air filters load with volcanic ash.

title: Conduit Brittle Fracture
bodyText: A sharp metallic report echoes from the sump floor: the secondary water return pipe has suffered a brittle fracture under -32°C ground freeze. Pressurized meltwater spurts into the battery trench, threatening to short out the emergency DC busbar.

title: Frostbite Sentry Collapse
bodyText: The exterior sentry on periscope watch reports loss of sensation in all ten fingers after clearing hoarfrost from the optical turret for forty minutes without insulated mitts. The skin has gone pale wax and blisters are swelling rapidly.

title: Allotment Cold-Frame Failure
bodyText: A messenger from The Works arrives on snowshoes: their primary seedling glasshouse collapsed under four feet of dense ash-snow. If they cannot secure auxiliary thermal coils within twenty-four hours, the spring carrot and legume crop is dead in the soil.

title: Diesel Fuel Cloud Gelling
bodyText: Paraffin wax crystals separate in the external fuel day-tank as diesel drops below -28°C. Fuel lines starve the auxiliary generator, causing the bunker lights to dim and cycle rapidly as the governor fights the thick sludge.

title: Exhaust Chimney Rime Choke
bodyText: Moisture from the heating stove freezes into a solid ring of rime ice around the exhaust flue orifice. Carbon monoxide levels in the dormitory stack creep up to 45 PPM before the mechanical alarm sounds.

title: Hoarfrost Periscope Blindness
bodyText: Dense ice crystals bridge the outer periscope prism. External surveillance is entirely blind until an engineer crawls through the crawlway with an alcohol spray bottle to de-ice the optics under 15 mSv/hr surface exposure.

title: Lead-Acid Electrolyte Slush
bodyText: Discharged backup batteries begin to freeze solid in the unheated battery vault. If the acid freezes into slush, the battery cases will split and ruin half of your emergency storage capacity permanently.

title: Hydraulic Blast Seal Freezing
bodyText: The hydraulic fluid in the inner airlock door rams turns viscous like cold molasses. The airlock takes four minutes to cycle instead of forty seconds, leaving entering scouts exposed in the decontamination chamber.

title: Sub-Zero Stasis Frustration
bodyText: Seventy consecutive days inside 150 square meters with zero daylight creates explosive friction. Two scavengers come to blows over an unwashed coffee mug, shattering an irreplaceable ceramic plate.

title: Garrison Registration Sweep
bodyText: A four-track armored personnel carrier halts at the ridge above your bunker. Garrison logistics officers set up an optical rangefinder and log your intake coordinates into the Sector 4 Martial Allocation grid, demanding written declaration of diesel stores.

title: Howitzer Shrapnel Concussion
bodyText: A stray 152mm high-explosive shell detonates 45 meters from your blast door, sending a seismic shockwave through the reinforced concrete foundation. Exterior periscope prisms shatter, and plaster dust rains down into the food storage alcoves.

title: Ash Sign Penitent Siege
bodyText: Chanting echoes down the ventilation chimney: twenty cultists in lead-lined ritual robes have gathered on your outer apron, setting a bonfire of sulfur and contaminated diesel to 'purify the unrepentant hole-dwellers.'

title: Hydro-Baron Pipeline Throttling
bodyText: Municipal water pressure in the main conduit drops to zero without warning. A radio transmission on the civil band announces that Sector 4 shelters have failed their extraction quota, and all downstream municipal supply is diverted to the refinery sluices.

title: D/9 Culvert Detonation
bodyText: A distant subterranean rumble shakes the floor as a Denial Detachment shaped charge destroys the Sector 4 railway culvert. The highway is severed; supply caravans are forced into the deep switchbacks.

title: Continuity Decree Promulgation
bodyText: Teletypes across the sector print the Continuity Allocation Order: all private food inventories exceeding 30 days per capita are declared martial reserve property, subject to immediate requisition by garrison flying columns.

title: Sector 4 Warlord Toll Ambush
bodyText: Armed technicals mount a barricade at the bridge approach. Gunfire crackles for twenty minutes as an independent medicine caravan is ransacked within two kilometers of your shelter perimeter.

title: Allotments Brass Embargo
bodyText: The Works announce a total halt on outbound clinic supplies to any facility that trades weapons to the Iron Garrison. Ottilie Frayne broadcasts: 'You cannot treat bullet wounds with bullets.'

title: Shrapnel Damaged Intake Cowl
bodyText: Steel fragments from an anti-aircraft engagement puncture the mushroom cowl of the fresh-air intake. High-activity dust bypasses the coarse screen, threatening the primary HEPA stage.

title: Garrison Summary Execution Squad
bodyText: A firing squad volley echoes across the frozen valley at dawn. Three conscripts who abandoned their posts at the coal depot are shot against the railway embankment.

title: The Black Mud Thaw
bodyText: Temperatures cross above +2°C for the first time in ten months. Ten billion tons of radioactive ash and snow liquefy into a toxic black mud slurry, inundating drainage swales and filling external periscope wells with radioactive silt.

title: Radon Fissure Venting
bodyText: Thawing permafrost opens microscopic fissures in the bedrock beneath your living quarters. Radon gas concentrations jump by 400%. The air scrubber core must be replaced before respiratory poisoning sets in across the sleeping stacks.

title: 142.850 MHz Carrier Signal
bodyText: The radio receiver catches a steady crystal carrier wave on 142.850 MHz. Between bursts of static, an automated synthesized voice repeats an eight-digit geographic grid and a date: Day 360, Northern Convoy departure.

title: Black Thaw Sump Inundation
bodyText: Thaw runoff overwhelms the lower drainage sumps. Irradiated silt and black meltwater rise three inches an hour, threatening the generator flywheel unless the backup 2-inch submersible pump is powered immediately.

title: Humid Spore Proliferation
bodyText: As internal humidity rises to 90% during the thaw, toxic black mold blooms across canvas cots and grain sacks. Three survivors develop severe respiratory wheezing within forty-eight hours.

title: Thawing Snowpack Discovery
bodyText: The receding snow line exposes dozens of casualties from the early winter migration. Scavengers and wild dogs gather along the ridge, creating acute biohazard and morale distress.

title: Aquifer Salt Shock
bodyText: Surface thaw water carrying dissolved calcium chloride and road salts breaches the shallow aquifer. Well water salinity jumps, requiring triple reverse-osmosis passes to remain potable.

title: Sound Pack Ice Calving
bodyText: Deep seismic booms reverberate through the ground as the northern sound pack ice fractures in the sunlight. The maritime channel is opening; the evacuation window approaches.

title: Aurora Borealis Manifest Call
bodyText: Teletype rolls churn out the final muster schedule: 'Vessel Aurora Borealis. Draft cleared. Final manifest deadline Day 358 at 1800 Zulu. Bring individual decontamination clearance certificates.'

title: Cold Count Provenance Publication
bodyText: The Low-Background Salt Lab releases its definitive findings: 'Analysis of strike signatures across all four sectors confirms zero human commanding authority existed when the final salvo launched.'

title: Permafrost Melt Subsidence
bodyText: The thaw of sub-surface permafrost lenses causes the north retaining wall to settle three centimeters, cracking the plaster in the pantry and pinching the fresh-air bypass damper.

title: Meltwater Geothermal Flashing
bodyText: Cold surface thaw water drains into the deep geothermal fissure, creating an explosive subterranean steam flash that shakes the bunker pipes and pops safety blow-off valves.

title: The First Green Shoots
bodyText: A radio dispatch from Tomas Lind at Plot 12: the perennial rye and winter vetch have sprouted through the black silt. 'The soil lives. We do not need the ships.'

title: D/9 Radio Carrier Stand-Down
bodyText: The carrier pulse on 142.850 MHz ceases abruptly. Signals Sergeant Ruhl transmits one final plaintext: 'Detachment 9 tasking complete. Detonator spools destroyed. Stand down.'

title: Garrison Headquarters Abandonment
bodyText: Smoke rises from the Garrison command compound as officers burn archives and load convoys. The conscript ranks have dissolved into civilian neighborhoods.

title: Dawn of Day 360
bodyText: A cold, pale sun breaks through the thinned stratospheric haze for the first time in one full year. The Geiger needle settles into the yellow. The first year of ash is survived.
